reviewType: Author independent literal recomputation and manual false-distractor semantic audit; not an external peer review

checks.boundaryNotes: 假設六小時流量固定，蒸發與側向入流已忽略，不外推融雪預報~Flows are constant for six hours; evaporation and lateral inflows are omitted, and no snowmelt forecast is implied
checks.misconception: 蓄量增加必然讓水位以固定比例上升~Every storage increase raises level in a fixed proportion

checks.boundaryNotes: 均勻法向壓力與連續理想拱圈，忽略接縫、基岩順應及三維彎矩~Uniform normal pressure on a continuous ideal arch strip; joints, foundation compliance and three-dimensional bending are excluded
checks.misconception: 只靠圓環平均壓應力就足以完成整座拱壩設計~Mean ring compression alone is sufficient for complete arch-dam design

checks.boundaryNotes: 單一線彈性反力方向，剛度屬假想整體支承，不表示岩盤試驗值~One linear reaction direction; stiffness represents a hypothetical support assembly rather than a measured rock property
checks.misconception: 岩石彈性模數可直接當成支承彈簧剛度~Rock elastic modulus can directly substitute for support spring stiffness

checks.boundaryNotes: 完全軸向拘束、線彈性且忽略徐變；正值表示冷卻所致拉應力量級~Full axial restraint, linear elasticity and no creep; the positive value is the tensile stress scale from cooling
checks.misconception: 每日氣溫變化就是整座壩體的平均溫變~Daily air-temperature change equals the mean temperature change of the entire dam

checks.boundaryNotes: 滿管穩流且使用達西摩擦因子，不是范寧因子；未計彎頭與入口~Steady full-pipe flow using the Darcy friction factor, not the Fanning factor; bends and entrance losses are excluded
checks.misconception: 沿程水頭損失只與流速一次方成比例~Friction head loss is proportional only to the first power of velocity

checks.boundaryNotes: 穩定水頭與流量，效率包含假想機電轉換但不含已扣除的水路損失~Constant head and discharge; assumed electromechanical efficiency excludes waterway losses already removed from net head
checks.misconception: 機組功率乘秒仍可直接標成兆瓦小時~Power multiplied by seconds can directly be labelled megawatt-hours

checks.boundaryNotes: 單相滿管、快速變化且不發生液柱分離；不是實際閥門操作指令~Single-phase full-pipe rapid change without column separation; this is not an actual valve operating instruction
checks.misconception: 一次水錘增量就是整條管線所有位置的最大壓力~One water-hammer increment is the maximum pressure at every pipeline location

checks.boundaryNotes: 穩定清水與總揚程，未計堵塞、含砂磨耗及備援需求，不是現場抽水計畫~Steady clean-water flow and total head; blockage, abrasion and standby requirements are excluded, so this is not a site dewatering plan
checks.misconception: 抽水電功率應將水力功率乘上效率~Pumping electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency

checks.boundaryNotes: 線性係數是假想校準值，變量範圍限於訓練資料，未計時間延遲~Coefficients are hypothetical calibrations restricted to the training range, with time lag omitted
checks.misconception: 監測回歸殘差很小即可證明結構完全安全~A small monitoring regression residual proves complete structural safety

checks.boundaryNotes: 半小時矩形入流脈衝、出口固定且無溢流，未指定實際下游運用~A thirty-minute rectangular inflow pulse with fixed outlet and no overflow, without specifying real downstream operation
checks.misconception: 每個放流脈衝都能重新使用緩衝池的全部容量~Every release pulse can reuse the entire buffer capacity from scratch

checks.boundaryNotes: 穩態體積與平均流量的尺度估算，沒有假設真實水庫完全混合~A steady-volume and mean-flow scale estimate, without asserting complete mixing in the actual reservoir
checks.misconception: 名目停留時間就是每滴水完全相同的水齡~Nominal residence time is the identical age of every water parcel

checks.boundaryNotes: 頂端位於自由液面的垂直矩形投影，靜水且尾水壓未計~A vertical rectangular projection starting at the free surface, with hydrostatic water and no downstream pressure
checks.misconception: 曲面水平水推力可直接用底壓乘全部曲面面積~Horizontal hydrostatic force equals bottom pressure times the entire curved area

checks.boundaryNotes: 線性並聯與共同位移，只示範力路分配，不提供局部應力~Linear parallel paths with shared displacement illustrate force distribution without predicting local stresses
checks.misconception: 一條力路變軟不會改變另一條力路的分力~Softening one load path leaves force in the other path unchanged

checks.boundaryNotes: 不計黏聚與側向約束，孔壓均勻；只算摩擦抗力不是安全係數~No cohesion or lateral confinement, with uniform pore pressure; the result is frictional resistance, not a safety factor
checks.misconception: 不必扣除孔隙水壓即可用總正向力算摩擦~Friction can use total normal force without deducting pore pressure

checks.boundaryNotes: 單一塊體自由伸長，未加入兩側塊體、拘束及初始縫寬~Free expansion of one block, excluding adjacent blocks, restraint and initial gap
checks.misconception: 單塊自由伸長必然等於接縫實際開口增量~Free expansion of one block necessarily equals actual joint opening

checks.boundaryNotes: 兩層近似、密度差小且水深為假想作用尺度，非設備臨界值~A small-density-difference two-layer approximation with hypothetical depth scale, not an equipment threshold
checks.misconception: 密度福祿數有適用所有取水口的固定允許值~Densimetric Froude number has one fixed permitted value for all intakes

checks.boundaryNotes: 三小時淨入流與水面積固定，沒有指定實際蓄洪空間或放流規則~Constant net inflow and surface area for three hours, without specifying real flood space or release rules
checks.misconception: 只知道水位增量就能判斷剩餘蓄洪空間~Knowing only level increment establishes remaining flood-storage capacity

checks.boundaryNotes: 水平矩形渠道、靜水壓斷面與一維動量；未提供真實消能池尺寸~Horizontal rectangular channel, hydrostatic sections and one-dimensional momentum, without sizing an actual basin
checks.misconception: 水躍同時保持動量函數與機械比能不變~A hydraulic jump conserves both momentum function and mechanical specific energy

checks.boundaryNotes: 兩小時代表濃度與流量固定，僅懸浮輸砂，不含推移質與庫內沉降~Constant representative concentration and flow for two hours; suspended load only, excluding bed load and reservoir deposition
checks.misconception: 濁度數值可以直接當作每立方公尺固體公斤數~A turbidity value directly equals kilograms of solids per cubic metre

checks.boundaryNotes: 充分混合、無反應的假想溶質，不表示濁度或飲用水合格限值~Complete mixing of a hypothetical nonreactive solute, not turbidity or a drinking-water acceptance limit
checks.misconception: 兩股流量不同時仍可把濃度直接取算術平均~Two concentrations can be averaged arithmetically even when source flows differ

checks.boundaryNotes: 飽和一維達西流、材料均勻無裂縫，截面固定且無側向逸流~Saturated one-dimensional Darcy flow through uniform uncracked materials with constant area and no lateral escape
checks.misconception: 沿流向串聯材料的係數應直接取算術平均~Permeabilities of layers in series should simply be averaged arithmetically

checks.boundaryNotes: 粒徑均為重量通過百分比的同單位數據，只作比值計算，不宣告材料合格~Both percentiles use the same size unit and mass-passing convention; this is a ratio calculation, not material acceptance
checks.misconception: 只要一個粒徑比值很小就可保證濾層合格~A sufficiently small single grain-size ratio guarantees filter acceptance

checks.boundaryNotes: 含水率以乾土質量為分母，體積為原濕試體體積，無超粒徑修正~Water content uses dry-solid mass and density uses the original wet specimen volume, without oversize correction
checks.misconception: 含水率百分之十二可直接以十二代入換算式~Twelve percent water content can be entered as twelve in the conversion

checks.boundaryNotes: 假想單一面上總法向力與均勻孔壓，未計滑動面需求或外水力矩~A hypothetical plane with total normal force and uniform pore pressure; slip demand and external-water moments are excluded
checks.misconception: 庫水位下降時土內孔壓一定立即等幅下降~Internal pore pressure always falls immediately by the same amount as reservoir level

checks.boundaryNotes: 無因次係數為假想值，只求等效水平慣性力，未選定設計地震~The coefficient is hypothetical and dimensionless; only equivalent horizontal inertia is calculated, without selecting a design earthquake
checks.misconception: 等效水平力計算完成就能排除地震永久變形~Calculating equivalent horizontal force rules out permanent seismic deformation

checks.boundaryNotes: 一時段乾固體收支閉合且密度均勻，未計庫岸崩塌與再懸浮交換~Closed dry-solids balance for one interval with uniform density, excluding bank failures and resuspension exchanges
checks.misconception: 入庫泥砂總質量全部等於當期永久庫容損失~All incoming sediment mass equals permanent capacity loss in that period

checks.boundaryNotes: 自由出流的假想孔口，水頭取孔口中心且不計下游淹沒~A hypothetical freely discharging orifice with head referenced to its center and no downstream submergence
checks.misconception: 孔口流量與水頭成正比而不是平方根關係~Orifice discharge is proportional to head rather than its square root

checks.boundaryNotes: 流量與代表濃度固定四十分鐘，質量為乾固體，不宣稱沉積全被移除~Constant representative discharge and concentration for forty minutes; mass is dry solids, without claiming complete deposit removal
checks.misconception: 只要放流水量大就能保證排出的泥砂很多~A large water release guarantees a large exported sediment mass

checks.boundaryNotes: 四十五分鐘恒定差額、無其他入流與蒸發，未指定實際後池容量~Constant imbalance for forty-five minutes with other inflows and evaporation omitted, without specifying actual afterbay capacity
checks.misconception: 每次脈衝都可以重新使用整座後池總容量~Every new pulse can reuse the entire gross afterbay capacity

checks.boundaryNotes: 單一路徑近似穩態，排除降雨脈衝與出口回水；不是滲透係數本身~One approximately steady path excluding rainfall pulses and outlet backwater; conductance is not permeability itself
checks.misconception: 排水量降低一定表示壩內滲流風險下降~Lower measured drainage always means reduced internal seepage risk

checks.boundaryNotes: 兩級相同穩定流量且水頭為各級淨值，未使用德基實際機組參數~Two stages share constant flow and stage-specific net heads; no actual Deji machine parameters are used
checks.misconception: 串聯兩級流量應先相加再乘上總水頭~Serial stage discharges should be added before multiplying by total head

checks.boundaryNotes: 靜止淡水的表壓，水深為假想值而非公開壩高或當前水位~Gauge pressure in still fresh water, with hypothetical depth rather than dam height or current reservoir level
checks.misconception: 壩高就是任何水位下都應使用的靜水深度~Structural dam height is the hydrostatic depth at every reservoir level

checks.boundaryNotes: 兩位移為沿原跨距連線方向的軸向投影，採小變形及同一穩定基準，只求跨距平均正應變~Both movements are axial projections along the original span line, using small deformation and one stable datum; only span-average normal strain is calculated
checks.misconception: 兩岸同向等量平移必然造成跨距增加~Equal translation of both abutments in one direction necessarily increases span

checks.boundaryNotes: 小密度差的特徵速度，未選經驗福祿係數或推定真實底流到達時間~A small-density-contrast velocity scale without an empirical Froude multiplier or a real arrival-time prediction
checks.misconception: 浮力速度尺度就是可直接預報的真實底流速度~The buoyancy velocity scale directly predicts the actual underflow speed

checks.boundaryNotes: 同一日邊界水量、損失已合併，未推定現行可引水量或水權~Boundary volumes cover the same day with combined losses, without asserting current diversion entitlement or available supply
checks.misconception: 跨流域水量可在來源與目的地總帳各算一次供水~Transferred water may count as new system supply at both source and destination

checks.boundaryNotes: 局部絕對壓力與指定蒸氣壓的假想狀態，不給定設備氣蝕臨界值~A hypothetical local absolute pressure and specified vapor pressure, without assigning an equipment cavitation threshold
checks.misconception: 表壓可以直接減去絕對蒸氣壓來算氣蝕指數~Gauge pressure can directly subtract absolute vapor pressure in a cavitation index

checks.boundaryNotes: 薄壁圓管膜拉應力，厚半徑比為零點零一六七，不含軸力與局部缺陷~Thin circular pipe membrane tension with thickness-radius ratio about 0.0167, excluding axial force and local defects
checks.misconception: 受拉薄壁管公式可直接證明受壓拱壩安全~A tensile thin-pipe equation directly proves the safety of a compressed arch dam

checks.boundaryNotes: 單一均勻管段且波速固定，只計傳播時間而非瞬變壓力~A single uniform pipe segment with constant wave speed; propagation time only, not transient pressure
checks.misconception: 壓力波傳播速度就是管內水的平均流速~Pressure-wave speed equals the mean velocity of water in the pipe

checks.boundaryNotes: 理想均勻取樣的奈奎斯特上限，實用通帶需低於此值並配濾波~Nyquist limit for ideal uniform sampling; practical passband must lie below it with suitable filtering
checks.misconception: 只要取樣率高就可以恢復感測器已飽和的峰值~A high sampling rate can recover peaks already clipped by sensor saturation

checks.boundaryNotes: 固定假想可用功率，僅計停機時段少發電量，不宣稱全部永遠損失~Constant hypothetical available power; energy absent during the outage only, not necessarily permanently lost
checks.misconception: 停機時段少發的電能必然全部永久損失~All generation absent during an outage is necessarily lost permanently

checks.boundaryNotes: 同一日封閉雙池系統，內部轉水抵銷，沒有額外下游天然入流~A two-pool daily system with internal transfers cancelling and no additional natural inflow to the lower pool
checks.misconception: 上下游間轉水會增加兩池合計的新水資源~Transfer between the two reservoirs creates additional combined water resources

checks.boundaryNotes: 飽和土單一法向分量，壓應力為正，未計剪應力或安全係數~One normal component in saturated soil with compression positive, excluding shear stress and a safety factor
checks.misconception: 孔隙水壓越高就一定讓土粒骨架承受更大壓應力~Higher pore pressure necessarily increases compression carried by the soil skeleton

checks.boundaryNotes: 均勻飽和達西流、固定有效截面，不代表現地排水層能力驗收~Uniform saturated Darcy flow through fixed effective area, not a field drain-capacity acceptance test
checks.misconception: 總排水量不變就能證明排水層各處都沒有堵塞~Unchanged total drainage proves that no part of the drain is blocked

checks.boundaryNotes: 假想矩形自由出流開口，水頭以開口中心計，未計尾水淹沒~A hypothetical rectangular free-discharge opening with head measured to its center and no tailwater submergence
checks.misconception: 不論尾水多高都可以使用相同自由出流公式~The same free-discharge equation applies regardless of tailwater level

checks.boundaryNotes: 耗散能量在假想面積上的平均分配，不是局部衝擊壓力或沖刷深度~Mean dissipated power over a hypothetical area, not local impact pressure or scour depth
checks.misconception: 每平方公尺耗散功率就是同數值的局部壓力~Dissipated power per area is the same numerical local pressure

checks.boundaryNotes: 一小時均勻假想懸浮濃度，非曾文實際設備排砂率或操作條件~One hour of uniform hypothetical suspended concentration, not actual Tsengwen equipment performance or operation
checks.misconception: 原水越濁就一定代表該時段排出總泥砂越多~Darker water necessarily means more total sediment was exported during the interval

checks.boundaryNotes: 同一放流先經假想機組再到下游，未計渠道損失或真實取水配置~One release passes a hypothetical unit before downstream use, excluding canal losses and actual withdrawal configuration
checks.misconception: 發電效率八成就表示兩成水量已被機組消耗~Eighty percent generation efficiency means the unit consumes twenty percent of the water

checks.boundaryNotes: 國際單位制曼寧式、棱柱矩形渠均勻流，糙率為假想值~SI Manning relation for uniform flow in a prismatic rectangular canal, with assumed roughness
checks.misconception: 矩形渠道的水力半徑永遠等於水深~Hydraulic radius of a rectangular canal always equals its depth

checks.boundaryNotes: 沉陷向下為正、兩次測量共用穩定基準，僅時段平均速率~Downward settlement is positive and both surveys share a stable datum; interval-average rate only
checks.misconception: 兩次量測求出的平均沉陷速率必定可永久線性外推~An average settlement rate from two surveys can always be extrapolated indefinitely

checks.boundaryNotes: 淨深度已扣有效降雨，效率含假想輸配損失，不再重複扣減~Net depth already excludes effective rainfall and efficiency includes assumed conveyance losses, with no second deduction
checks.misconception: 毛取水量應把田間淨需水乘上輸配效率~Gross withdrawal equals net field requirement multiplied by delivery efficiency

checks.boundaryNotes: 同一日實收水量，損失合併表示，非目前實際供水或引水配額~Volumes received during one day with combined losses, not current supply or diversion allocations
checks.misconception: 來源河川的全部流量都可直接列為水庫實收入流~All source-river discharge can be entered as water actually received by the reservoir

checks.boundaryNotes: 兩高程間面積線性近似，只求區間增量，不是水庫總容量~Linear area interpolation between two elevations; interval increment only, not total reservoir capacity
checks.misconception: 區間庫容等於上下水面積之差乘上高程差~Interval storage equals the difference in water areas times elevation difference

checks.boundaryNotes: 假想無反應溶質且充分混合，不是飲用水標準或濁度混合公式~A hypothetical nonreactive solute with complete mixing, not a drinking-water standard or turbidity relation
checks.misconception: 兩來源濃度可不管流量比例直接取算術平均~Two source concentrations can be averaged without considering their flow proportions

checks.boundaryNotes: 穩定假想流量與總效率，不是南化既有管線設計或運轉資料~Steady hypothetical flow and overall efficiency, not design or operating data for an existing Nanhua pipeline
checks.misconception: 抽水輸入功率應低於同流量揚程的理想水力功率~Pumping electrical input should be lower than the ideal hydraulic power at the same duty

checks.boundaryNotes: 共因事件必使雙路失效；無共因時兩路條件獨立，機率同屬一時段~The common event disables both paths; otherwise failures are conditionally independent over the same time interval
checks.misconception: 有兩條供水路徑就可以保證故障彼此獨立~Having two supply routes guarantees that their failures are independent

checks.boundaryNotes: 同一高程基準的假想垂直餘量，波浪項不含重複計入，不是設計準則~Hypothetical vertical allowances sharing one datum, with wave terms not double counted; not a design criterion
checks.misconception: 只要幾何壩頂高於靜水面就完全不必考慮波浪~A crest above still water never needs any wave consideration

checks.boundaryNotes: 事件總體積且係數無因次，未描述洪峰、匯流歷時與取水限制~Event volume with a dimensionless coefficient, excluding peak flow, routing duration and abstraction constraints
checks.misconception: 總逕流體積可直接當作暴雨洪峰流量~Total runoff volume can directly be treated as peak storm discharge

checks.boundaryNotes: 固定假想淨淤積率的比例估算，沒有預測洪水事件或實際剩餘壽命~A ratio under constant hypothetical net deposition, without forecasting storm events or actual remaining service life
checks.misconception: 庫容除年淤積量就是確定無誤的水庫剩餘壽命~Storage divided by annual deposition is the exact remaining reservoir lifetime

checks.boundaryNotes: 無入流、無其他損失且削減比例可實現，僅作靜態比較~No inflow or other losses and an achievable reduction fraction, for static comparison only
checks.misconception: 需求降低百分之十五就使續供天數恰增加百分之十五~Reducing demand fifteen percent increases supply duration by exactly fifteen percent

checks.boundaryNotes: 兩標準不確定度獨立且流量同步穩態，無蓄量變化；比值不是機率~Independent standard uncertainties and synchronized steady flows with no storage change; the ratio is not a probability
checks.misconception: 正規化水量差數值就是管線漏水的百分比機率~The normalized flow imbalance directly equals the percentage probability of leakage
